inputs.frozen_forecast: scorecard v3 canonical capture (latest at or before first kickoff minus 20 minutes)

vacancy.recency: appeared for current team in at least one of the team's last 3 completed games

QB.rule: team passing leader in its most recent completed game

beneficiaries.must_be: same franchise, not isOut, has salary

candidates.C1: beneficiary field points = our projection only

C2.applied: after v5 flattening, every allocation weight (Classic; Showdown flex main pool, punt tier, captain)

metrics.format_mae: mean over slates of per-slate MAE
metrics.flagged_group: beneficiaries with an observed or reconciled_zero label
metrics.observed_population: every player with an observed or reconciled_zero label

design.slates: 2026 slates with first kickoff before 2026-10-25T00:00:00Z, a canonical frozen forecast and a stored reference contest
design.step1_premise: pool design slates; top 10 by (actual - v5); proceed only if beneficiary share among them > 2 x beneficiary share of the observed population, else NOT_BUILT
design.step3_choose: lowest flagged-group MAE among admissible C1 and C2 points; ties to C1 then smaller m; NOT_BUILT if none admissible or winner not below v5 flagged-group MAE
design.freeze_table: nfl_ownership_news_freezes (append-only, one row per format, frozen_at set once)

grading.gradable: first kickoff >= 2026-10-25T00:00:00Z AND canonical frozen forecast on the reference contest AND nfl_dfs_field_contests.imported_at > frozen_at AND >= 1 labeled beneficiary
grading.primary: mean over slates of (challenger - v5) flagged-group MAE

unlabeled_beneficiaries.worst_case: each unresolved row adds |challenger - v5| to the challenger's error only

verdict.PASS: primary upper bound < 0 under both treatments AND guard upper bound within its limit
verdict.FAIL: primary point estimate >= 0 under either treatment OR guard point estimate above its limit
verdict.INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise, or floors unmet at season end
